name: spec
description: Full project lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis-architect → /spec:genesis-explore's fresh-UX-research candidate funnel and design pick → /spec:genesis-design ratifying the winner's tokens-as-code) → roadmap briefs with declared surfaces → per-brief /spec:sketch workbench (mock + brainstorm one brief, ratify before planning) → plan → mock-always design (local responsive HTML mocks under a render-critique harness covering the declared theme×viewport matrix; Claude Design demoted to escape hatch) → build → review → per-milestone /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas (the deterministic whole-product design view: journey graph, gap cards, annotation loop), with deterministic workflows, a hook-enforced state machine, per-repo grounding bootstrapped by /spec:init (activation-verified via its deliverable manifest; session grounding included — path-scoped rules, a generated permissions allowlist, run + verify skills), executed-boot and skipped-test gates behind every review verdict, deterministic rule enforcement generated by /spec:enforce, and a closed feedback loop: release flushes host findings into version-stamped briefs, the shipped intake ledger returns fixed-upstream signals through /spec:doctor, and /spec:status — the glanceable derived where-am-I view (roadmap/spec status + skip anomalies) behind one deterministic script shared with doctor and plan's dependency preflight (brief dependencies parsed item-wise, so spec references in a Depends-on header surface as anomalies instead of phantom blockers), and plan's lock step captures session-discovered follow-up work as roadmap briefs before context dies; /spec:review now reconciles the full unscoped diff against the File Plan via scope-reconcile.js — out-of-plan changes are a mechanical hard finding and get reviewed, planned-but-untouched files are a mechanical soft finding, and /spec:build's Final gate surfaces the same signal advisory (rename exemption is conditional — an unplanned file's rename stays a hard finding); the review/release verdict word is now a derived value, never model prose — verdict.js reads a fresh per-iteration evidence manifest (Phase 0 legs append rows, re-executed each fix-delta iteration) plus the workflow return and disposition counts to produce the one word and ledger row printed/appended verbatim, gating the close step on its exit code; CI status flows through the shared ci-query.js wrapper as one more manifest leg (red blocks pre-panel, unavailable never blocks); /spec:release adopts the same derivation under a release profile with production as a required leg, wired on both its fail-fast STOP path and its Phase 4 success path; the ledger row itself is now complete — review rows carry runId (via --run-id, sourced from the wf-review Workflow invocation) plus manifest-derived smoke/testsSkipped, and release rows carry orchestrator-supplied milestone/briefs identity fields alongside manifest-derived staging/e2e/journeys/substrate/production, closing the gap between what review.md/release.md documented and what verdict.js actually emitted; `done` now carries a derived observation sub-state — observe-ci.js (built on ci-query.js) appends ancestry-validated stage:"observe" rows to the run ledger at the next /spec:status or /spec:review invocation (no daemon), spec-status.js renders done-unobserved/done-but-red and turns a red observation into the dashboard headline plus the --next top pick as a full oracle-shaped /spec:escape entry, and /spec:escape gains a red-observation derive path that reads the failing run and refuses to record against a spec the run doesn't implicate — closing the window where a green dashboard could coexist with a silently red run of the landed code; spec/INTAKE.md's accepted-findings table now carries a `Fix` column (`mechanism(<path>)` | `prose(<reason>)` | `—` | `pre-contract`) and a repeat-Category row may only close `prose(...)` with a stated impossibility reason — enforced every suite run by tests/intake/intake-discipline.test.js, so a recurring incident class can no longer get a second prose patch instead of a mechanism
